steps.note: Open the eRFX project creation screen.
Enable eRFX project creation required by the case.
Allow vendors to be added during event creation and publishing.
Every successful create test needs a searchable event title.
Create the required Technical and RFQ stages.
configure the rfp stage on its own tab
rfp needs its own template
Add the requested line item for the RFQ.
configure the rfq stage on its own tab
rfq needs its own template
Invite one QA vendor for the event without inventing a company name.
Commit the 30-minute event schedule.
Publish the configured two-stage event.
Verify that publishing reached a real project page.
Have the invited vendor submit the Technical response and quote 100, including the vendor-side submission flow.
Assert that the vendor submission was accepted.
Inspect the invited vendor's portal after submission.
Open the Technical-stage vendor view to inspect the mandatory clauses.
Verify the first configured clause is shown to the vendor on the Technical stage.
Verify the second configured clause is shown to the vendor on the Technical stage.
Open the RFQ pricing view to check that Technical-stage clauses do not carry over.
Verify the first Technical-only clause is not requested on the RFQ stage.
Verify the second Technical-only clause is not requested on the RFQ stage.
Return to the buyer's project page for the final buyer-side observation.
